ending.narrationWaterMemory: The waters of Harie distill countless landscapes into a single thread of memory.
ending.narrationFallenPetals: Petals return to the earth, nourish the roots, and come the following year, new flowers bloom once more.
ending.narrationRiversReturn:
A hundred rivers flow into the sea, and so passes all that has gone.
Yet still they gather into clouds, become rain, and return to the mountains and streams.
ending.narrationTwelveDegreeWater: That twelve-degree water hides a warmth within its cold,
ending.narrationTravelers: Urging onward those who depart, and slaking the thirst of those who return.
ending.narrationWaterKeepsAsking: Even should the village empty, the water will keep asking—
ending.narrationWhereToReturn: "Where do you live, and where do you wish to return?"
ending.narrationEternalHome: As long as the sound of water endures, this land will forever remain someone's home.
ending.authorCommentFallback: The author's commentary is still being prepared.
